executive_assessment.text: The report projects the population share adversely affected by rainfall to rise to 16% by 2050 under a moderate-emissions scenario and 44% under a high-emissions scenario.

The CCDR reports that over 60% of Liberia’s urban population lives in informal settlements and that wetland and floodplain development in Greater Monrovia leaves dwellings waterlogged and flooded during the rainy season.
The report says Liberia lacks adequate baseline data on floods, windstorms, heat waves, and droughts; only Greater Monrovia had a detailed flood assessment in the cited discussion.
